title: RestaurantOS
description: A real-time restaurant management system for five roles on the same shift — ordering, kitchen ops, fair assignment, delivery logistics, inventory integrity, and a salary engine, under the Ember brand.
features: Real-time ordering across customer, cook, service, delivery, and admin roles
Fair order assignment engine with pause detection and stale-order rotation
PhotoView visual table management on real restaurant photos
Atomic inventory with low-stock auto-hiding and delivery map integration
Salary engine with per-role scoring weights, bonuses, and month closure
challenges: Inventory race conditions under concurrent orders — solved with atomic Prisma updates guarded by quantityOnHand: { gte: requiredQty }.
Timezone bugs that silently corrupted salary data — fixed by an all-UTC backend converted only at display time.
Render free tier blocking SMTP — replaced with Brevo's HTTP API, and cron moved to an external job service.
